name: Linley Jones
tagline: Top rated Professional Liability attorney in Atlanta, Georgia
education: Georgia State University College of Law
about: Linley Jones has practiced over 30 years as a plaintiffs' lawyer specializing in legal malpractice and personal injury. She is Past President of the Georgia Trial Lawyers Association and the first woman lawyer in the United States to be board-certified in legal malpractice by the American Board of Professional Liability Attorneys (an ABA-approved certification board). She now serves on the Board of Governors. Linley Jones has been selected to the Georgia Super Lawyer list every year since 2004, she has repeatedly been recognized as one of the top 100 lawyers in Georgia and one of the top 50 women lawyers in Georgia. Linley Jones is a distinguished and successful trial attorney with numerous unique accomplishments in personal injury and legal malpractice law.

Ms. Jones' hard work has earned her an *AV-Preeminent rating from Martindale-Hubbell Lawyers Directory. After graduating from the Georgia State University College of Law as a Fuller Callaway Scholar, Ms. Jones was admitted to the Georgia Bar in 1992. She opened The Linley Jones Firm, P.C., in Atlanta, Georgia, where she continues her work with personal injury and legal malpractice cases.

Ms. Jones is locally and nationally known for cases involving legal malpractice, wrongful death and catastrophic injury. She is acclaimed for her advocacy in legal malpractice cases against other attorneys and professionals. In addition, she has written many, many legal articles and often lectures on these topics.

*AV Preeminent and BV Distinguished are certification marks of Reed Elsevier Properties Inc., used in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell is the facilitator of a peer review rating process. Ratings reflect the confidential opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell ratings fall into two categories - legal ability and general ethical standards.
